<h1 id="agent-skills-mcp-servers-query-service">agent-skills / mcp-servers query service v1.4.0</h1>


Hybrid search over the agent_skills and mcp_servers Qdrant collections (read-only), a non-deterministic LLM threat scan for skill text (POST /scan), and a scan-and-record path that writes the verdict onto the skill's Qdrant point (POST /scan/skill).

<h1 id="agent-skills-mcp-servers-query-service-default">Default</h1>

## Scan

<a id="opIdscan_scan_post"></a>

> Code samples

```shell

curl -X POST /scan \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'

```

```python
import requests
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  'Accept': 'application/json'
}

r = requests.post('/scan', headers = headers)

print(r.json())

```

`POST /scan`

Non-deterministic threat scan: send the skill text to an LLM (litellm /
OpenRouter) with the Cisco threat-analysis prompt and return its structured
findings / overall_assessment / primary_threats verdict. See scan_service.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "skill_text": "string",
  "skill_name": "",
  "model": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="scan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ScanRequest](#schemascanrequest)|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "model": "string",
  "prompt_version": "string",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "aitech": "string",
      "title": "string",
      "description": "string",
      "aisubtech": "string",
      "location": "string",
      "evidence": "string",
      "remediation": "string"
    }
  ],
  "overall_assessment": "string",
  "primary_threats": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="scan-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|[OK](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.3.1)|Successful Response|[ScanResponse](#schemascanresponse)|

## Scan Skill

<a id="opIdscan_skill_scan_skill_post"></a>

> Code samples

```shell
# You can also use wget
curl -X POST /scan/skill \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'

```

```python
import requests
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  'Accept': 'application/json'
}

r = requests.post('/scan/skill', headers = headers)

print(r.json())

```

`POST /scan/skill`

Scan an already-indexed skill and record the verdict on its Qdrant point.

Identify the skill by `point_id` (or `content_hash`); the service reads its
SKILL.md text, runs the same non-deterministic scan as POST /scan, writes a
top-level `llm_scan` payload field, and returns it. A recent scan for
unchanged content + model + prompt is reused (`skipped: true`) unless
`force: true`. See scan_index.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "point_id": "string",
  "content_hash": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "force": false
}
```

<h3 id="scan-skill-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ScanSkillRequest](#schemascanskillrequest)|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "point_id": "string",
  "skipped": true,
  "reason": "string",
  "llm_scan": {
    "model": "string",
    "prompt_version": "string",
    "scanned_at": "string",
    "content_sha256": "string",
    "max_severity": "CRITICAL",
    "finding_count": 0,
    "primary_threats": [
      "string"
    ],
    "overall_assessment": "string",
    "findings": [
      {
        "severity": "CRITICAL",
        "aitech": "string",
        "title": "string",
        "description": "string",
        "aisubtech": "string",
        "location": "string",
        "evidence": "string",
        "remediation": "string"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<h3 id="scan-skill-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|[OK](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.3.1)|Successful Response|[ScanSkillResponse](#schemascanskillresponse)|
|404|[Not Found](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.5.4)|No agent_skills point matched point_id / content_hash|None|
|422|[Unprocessable Entity](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2518#section-10.3)|Validation Error|[HTTPValidationError](#schemahttpvalidationerror)|
|502|[Bad Gateway](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.6.3)|Upstream LLM call failed or returned unparseable output|None|
|503|[Service Unavailable](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.6.4)|Scan LLM not configured (no API key)|None|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

or

|languages|[string]|false|none|skill only: only return hits whose language is in this list.|
